# Multiple sections

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

You can use messages of type `section`to group different message types. This feature is useful when you want to have multiple sidebars with different colors or footers to group your message content.

Inside the `sections` array you can add your message type.

## Example

![Example](/img/1560465812636.png)

## JSON example

```json
{
    "head": {
        "text": "I am a header",
        "sub_head": {
            "text": "I am a sub header"
        }
    },
    "body": [
        {
            "type": "section",
            "sidebar_color": "#ffffff",
            "sections": [
                {
                    "type": "message",
                    "text": "I am a message with text"
                }
            ],
            "footer": "I am a footer",
            "footer_icon": "https://d24cgw3uvb9a9h.cloudfront.net/static/93516/image/new/ZoomLogo.png",
            "ts": 1560446471819
        },
        {
            "type": "section",
            "sidebar_color": "#F56416",
            "sections": [
                {
                    "type": "message",
                    "text": "I am a message with text"
                }
            ],
            "footer": "I am a footer",
            "footer_icon": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/5/58/San_Francisco_Giants_Logo.svg/1200px-San_Francisco_Giants_Logo.svg.png",
            "ts": 1560446471819
        }
    ]
}
```
